title: Bianca Caragliano Stock Pitch Competition 2027
summary: Submit a one-page investment thesis; selected teams present investment analysis.
eligibility: Undergraduates worldwide, any major or year; teams from the same university, faculty adviser mandatory.
notes: Competition 9–10 April 2027. Two hotel rooms per team, meals and up to $1,000 transportation reimbursement subject to organizer rules.
